==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|
*Speak with [[Aris]] in her tent in [[Varrock Square]] and give her 1 gp. {{Chat option|1Yes.|2Okay, where is he? I'll kill him for you!|3So how did Wally kill Delrith?|4Where can I find Silverlight?}}, or {{Chat option|1The Demon Slayer Quest|1Ok, here you go.|2Okay, where is he? I'll kill him for you!|3So how did Wally kill Delrith?|4Where can I find Silverlight?}} if you've started [[Recipe for Disaster]]
**'''Remember the incantation [[Wally]] chants in the cutscene as it varies from player to player.''' If you forget it speak to Aris again and ask her about what the magical incantation was.
*Speak to [[Sir Prysin]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} at the south-west corner of [[Varrock palace]] {{Chat option|3Aris said I should come and talk to you.|1I need to find Silverlight.|2He's back and unfortunately I've got to deal with him.|2And why is this a problem?}}
}}

===First key===
{{Checklist|
*Go to north-west corner of the palace and go up two flights of stairs.
*Speak to [[Captain Rovin]] in the north-west tower on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} about the demon. {{Chat option|3Yes I know, but this is important.|1There's a demon who wants to invade this city.|2Yes, very.|2It's not them who are going to fight the demon, it's me.|3Sir Prysin said you would give me the key.|1Why did he give you one of the keys then?}}
}}

===Second key===
{{Checklist|
*Go to the kitchen to the north-east, on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}.
**If you don't have a bucket of water, head up the staircase in the kitchen and grab one from the room to the east. Head back down to the kitchen and fill the bucket from the sink.
*Use a bucket of water on the [[Drain (Demon Slayer)|drain]] outside of the eastern kitchen wall.
*Climb down the [[manhole]] east of the palace, just outside the wall near the tree patch.
*Take the north-west path down to the end and take the rusty Silverlight key from the floor. (It does not appear on the minimap)
}}

===Third key===
{{Checklist|
*Take 25 un-noted bones from your bank.
**[[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] Ultimate Ironmen: You can deliver the bones a few at a time. You do not have to deliver all 25 at once.
*Go to [[Wizards' Tower]] (south of [[Draynor Village]]) ([[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|DIS}}).
*Climb up the stairs and talk to [[Wizard Traiborn]]. {{Chat option|1Talk about Demon Slayer.|3Well, have you got any keys knocking around?|2I'll get the bones for you.}}
*He will ask for 25 [[bones]] (noted will not work); bring him these and he will give you his key.
}}

===Delrith===
{{Checklist|
*Return to Sir Prysin (south-west room of Varrock Castle) and give him the keys.
*Wield Silverlight and go to the [[Dark wizard]]s by Varrock's south entrance. A cutscene will occur.
*Defeat [[Delrith]]; right-click Delrith and banish him with the incantation seen earlier. The incantation varies from player to player; Aris will remind players of the incantation if forgotten.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
